process.detail: Free 30-minute call to understand the problem and goals.
A clear scope, price and timeline within 48 hours.
Built in weekly sprints, with a live demo every week.
Deployment, handover, and an optional retainer.

faq.a: Yes, I'm happy to sign your NDA before we discuss the details of your project.

Starting prices are ₹35,000 for websites, ₹80,000 for CRM, ERP and SaaS products, and ₹70,000 for AI automation. The final price depends on scope (pages and design, modules and workflows, integrations, data) and on how many users it needs to handle. You get a fixed quote after a free scoping call.

Instead of paying for the full build upfront, you pay a smaller setup fee and a monthly fee. I own and maintain the product and you use it under licence, with hosting, maintenance and small changes included. The minimum term is 12 months, you can buy the code outright later, and your data is always yours.
Payments are milestone-based, with the milestones and amounts agreed in each project's quote.

Every project includes 30 days of bug fixes after launch. After that, a monthly care plan (from ₹3,000) covers hosting, security updates, monitoring and backups. It's included in a lease, required for anything hosted or run for you (including AI automations), and optional but recommended if you take over hosting yourself. New features run on a monthly retainer from ₹15,000.

faq.q: Will it handle more users as I grow?
faq.a: Apps and AI builds are scoped to a scale tier: up to about 100 users, up to about 1,000, or 10,000 or more. Higher tiers add server and database sizing and load testing, and the monthly care plan rises with them.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside India?
faq.a: I mainly work with clients in India. International projects are welcome by arrangement.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: It depends on scope. Your fixed quote includes a timeline, and you'll see a live demo of progress every week.
Send a short brief using the form or by email. I'll reply to set up a free 30-minute scoping call, then send a fixed quote within 48 hours.

scale.intro: Every app and AI build is sized to a user count, so it keeps working as you grow. Higher tiers add server and database sizing and load testing to the build, and raise the monthly care plan.
